description:
Navigate to the Reports module in Manager.io (Northwind Traders). Generate a Profit and Loss Statement for the period from 2024-03-01 to 2024-03-31.

Read the report and create a file at '/home/ga/Documents/pnl_report.txt' with the following exact format (replace <amount> with the numeric values from the report):

Total Income: <amount>
Total Expenses: <amount>
Net Profit: <amount>

Use the exact labels shown above. Do not include currency symbols ($), just the numbers.
